svg.title: Nested SegWit address construction
svg.desc: Bob's public key goes through HASH160 and gets OP_0 in front, giving his 22-byte P2WPKH output script. That script becomes a P2SH redeem script: HASH160 turns it into a 20-byte script hash, and Base58Check with version byte 0x05 and a double-SHA256 checksum turns that into a 34-character address beginning with 3.

text.tspan: Redeem script: Bob's P2WPKH output script
HASH160, then put OP_0 in front (see P2WPKH figure)
